_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.py builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = clean, because the only C# (the server-role composer) registers into DI; the JSON profiles are bound into Umbraco's options classes by the fixture, not loaded by the site. Placeholder values are deliberately obvious fakes: a URL that passes Umbraco's production validators, and Key Vault URIs so the no-literal-secrets assertion has something to inspect. No requires: nothing here needs a content node.
